name: Medina County's Secret Blueberry Patch
description: Medina County's Secret Blueberry Patch grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples in 664 Lafayette Rd, OH. The farm is working, and its seasons run through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
